title: Nuclear weapons, 1945-2015
claim_summary: Global, U.S., and Russian/Soviet nuclear arsenals declined after Cold War peaks.
book_citation: HumanProgress static 2927, based on Federation of Atomic Scientists, Kristensen & Norris 2016a, updated in Kristensen 2016.
notes: Archived HumanProgress static 2927 was recovered with 138 non-generated United States and USSR/Russia observations, all preserved exactly. The stacked-area reconstruction uses current same-institution FAS-derived successor values only for the six thin minor-country layers. No post-2015 extension is plotted. Status remains partial_match because the exact 2016 minor-country vintage is unresolved.

data_fidelity.minor_series_limitation: France, China, United Kingdom, Pakistan, India, and Israel use a later FAS-derived successor vintage.
